From 56007972c0b1e783ca714d6f1f4d6e66e531d21f Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Alexander Koskovich <akoskovich@pm.me>
Date: Fri, 3 Apr 2026 18:43:48 +0200
Subject: [PATCH] net: ipa: fix event ring index not programmed for IPA v5.0+

For IPA v5.0+, the event ring index field moved from CH_C_CNTXT_0 to
CH_C_CNTXT_1. The v5.0 register definition intended to define this
field in the CH_C_CNTXT_1 fmask array but used the old identifier of
ERINDEX instead of CH_ERINDEX.

Without a valid event ring, GSI channels could never signal transfer
completions. This caused gsi_channel_trans_quiesce() to block
forever in wait_for_completion().

At least for IPA v5.2 this resolves an issue seen where runtime
suspend, system suspend, and remoteproc stop all hanged forever. It
also meant the IPA data path was completely non functional.

Fixes: faf0678ec8a0 ("net: ipa: add IPA v5.0 GSI register definitions")
Signed-off-by: Alexander Koskovich <akoskovich@pm.me>
Signed-off-by: Luca Weiss <luca.weiss@fairphone.com>
Reviewed-by: Simon Horman <horms@kernel.org>
Link: https://patch.msgid.link/20260403-milos-ipa-v1-2-01e9e4e03d3e@fairphone.com
Signed-off-by: Paolo Abeni <pabeni@redhat.com>

diff --git a/drivers/net/ipa/reg/gsi_reg-v5.0.c b/drivers/net/ipa/reg/gsi_reg-v5.0.c
index 3334d8e20ad2..6c4a7fbe4de9 100644
--- a/drivers/net/ipa/reg/gsi_reg-v5.0.c
+++ b/drivers/net/ipa/reg/gsi_reg-v5.0.c
@@ -30,7 +30,7 @@ REG_STRIDE_FIELDS(CH_C_CNTXT_0, ch_c_cntxt_0,
 
 static const u32 reg_ch_c_cntxt_1_fmask[] = {
 	[CH_R_LENGTH]					= GENMASK(23, 0),
-	[ERINDEX]					= GENMASK(31, 24),
+	[CH_ERINDEX]					= GENMASK(31, 24),
 };
 
 REG_STRIDE_FIELDS(CH_C_CNTXT_1, ch_c_cntxt_1,
-- 
2.34.1

The patch modifies a single file, `drivers/net/ipa/reg/gsi_reg-v5.0.c`, to fix a bug in the GSI register definitions for IPA v5.0+. The change replaces the incorrect field identifier `ERINDEX` with the correct `CH_ERINDEX` in the `reg_ch_c_cntxt_1_fmask[]` array, which defines the bitmask for the `CH_C_CNTXT_1` register. This ensures the event ring index is properly programmed for IPA v5.0+, resolving issues where GSI channels could never signal transfer completions, causing hangs during runtime suspend, system suspend, and remoteproc stop, as well as a completely non-functional data path. The fix directly addresses the misplacement of the field definition between register context words, making the event ring index assignment work correctly.

Here is the commit message:
net: ipa: fix event ring index not programmed for IPA v5.0+

For IPA v5.0+, the event ring index field moved from CH_C_CNTXT_0 to
CH_C_CNTXT_1. The v5.0 register definition intended to define this
field in the CH_C_CNTXT_1 fmask array but used the old identifier of
ERINDEX instead of CH_ERINDEX.

Without a valid event ring, GSI channels could never signal transfer
completions. This caused gsi_channel_trans_quiesce() to block
forever in wait_for_completion().

At least for IPA v5.2 this resolves an issue seen where runtime
suspend, system suspend, and remoteproc stop all hanged forever. It
also meant the IPA data path was completely non functional.

Fixes: faf0678ec8a0 ("net: ipa: add IPA v5.0 GSI register definitions")
Signed-off-by: Alexander Koskovich <akoskovich@pm.me>
Signed-off-by: Luca Weiss <luca.weiss@fairphone.com>
Reviewed-by: Simon Horman <horms@kernel.org>
Link: https://patch.msgid.link/20260403-milos-ipa-v1-2-01e9e4e03d3e@fairphone.com
Signed-off-by: Paolo Abeni <pabeni@redhat.com>

Here is the root cause:
The register field mask array for the CH_C_CNTXT_1 register in the IPA v5.0 GSI definitions used the wrong identifier "ERINDEX" instead of the correct "CH_ERINDEX". This misdefinition prevented the event ring index from being programmed correctly for IPA v5.0+, causing GSI channels to fail signaling transfer completions, leading to hangs and non-functional data paths.

Here is the patch:
 static const u32 reg_ch_c_cntxt_1_fmask[] = {
 	[CH_R_LENGTH]					= GENMASK(23, 0),
-	[ERINDEX]					= GENMASK(31, 24),
+	[CH_ERINDEX]					= GENMASK(31, 24),
 };

The code statements that lead to the bug are:
[ERINDEX]					= GENMASK(31, 24),
Reason:
The fmask array for `reg_ch_c_cntxt_1` incorrectly uses `ERINDEX` (which is the identifier for the event ring index field in the `CH_C_CNTXT_0` register) instead of `CH_ERINDEX` (the correct identifier for the same field in `CH_C_CNTXT_1` on IPA v5.0+). This misdefinition causes the event ring index to never be programmed into the `CH_C_CNTXT_1` register, leaving GSI channels without a valid event ring. As a result, transfer completions are never signaled, leading to `gsi_channel_trans_quiesce()` hanging indefinitely and the entire IPA data path becoming non‑functional.

The code statements that fix the bug are:
[CH_ERINDEX]				= GENMASK(31, 24),
Reason:
Replacing `ERINDEX` with `CH_ERINDEX` correctly maps the bit field to the event ring index in the `CH_C_CNTXT_1` register for IPA v5.0+. This ensures that the event ring is properly programmed when configuring GSI channels, allowing transfer completions to be signaled normally and resolving the hangs in runtime suspend, system suspend, and remoteproc stop.
